name: io.github.sus-tech-gmbh/matrix42-mcp
title: Matrix42
description: MCP server for Matrix42: explore the API and data model, search the service desk, act on tickets

environmentVariables.name: M42_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Matrix42 instance

environmentVariables.name: M42_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token created in the Matrix42 Administration application

environmentVariables.name: M42_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Expose the tools that modify tickets. Off by default, which keeps the server read-only

environmentVariables.name: M42_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Response language, sent as the Explicit-Language header

environmentVariables.name: M42_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool ids to expose. Left unset, all tools are exposed

environmentVariables.name: M42_AUDIT_NOTE
environmentVariables.description: Mark created tickets with an internal note saying they were raised through this server

environmentVariables.name: M42_AGENT_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: How the assistant is named in that note

environmentVariables.name: M42_UI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of the web interface, for deep links. Discovered from the instance when unset

environmentVariables.name: M42_ALLOW_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Only for self-signed development instances
